title: Newmark Arranges $56.25 Million Sale of 4075 Wilson Boulevard in Arlington, Virginia

body_markdown:
**September 24, 2026 9:00 AM**
Newmark announces the Company has arranged the $56.25 million sale of 4075 Wilson Boulevard, a 188,014-square-foot Class A office property in Arlington’s Ballston submarket. An institutional investor acquired the property from FarmViewVentures LLC, Rithm Capital Corp. and GreenBarn Investment Group.


Newmark Capital Markets Executive Managing Directors[Jud Ryan](https://www.nmrk.com/people/jud-ryan) and[James P. Cassidy](https://www.nmrk.com/people/james-p-cassidy) , along with Vice President[Grant Marley](https://www.nmrk.com/people/grant-marley) represented the seller in the transaction.


“4075 Wilson Boulevard represents the first-round trip office investment during the current office cycle thanks to ownership’s successful repositioning strategy in one of our region’s most vibrant submarkets,” said Ryan. “The transaction reflects continued investor demand for well-positioned assets with durable tenant rosters and compelling long-term fundamentals.”


The tenant roster includes Nalej Corporation, KnowBe4, Systems Planning & Analysis and OpenText Public Sector, among other government contractors, technology companies and professional services firms. Ownership executed more than 90,000 square feet of new leasing following its acquisition of the property in September 2024.


The property has benefited from more than $6 million in strategic capital improvements, including a newly delivered tenant amenity center with conference facilities, a tenant lounge and golf simulator, as well as an upgraded lobby and renovated rooftop terrace. Its ground-floor retail is fully leased to tenants including Sweetgreen, Grazie Nonna, Van Leeuwen Ice Cream and Pinnacle Bank.


Located at Wilson Boulevard and North Randolph Street, 4075 Wilson Boulevard is directly across from Ballston Quarter and near the Ballston Metro station, with access to I-66 and Route 50. The property also sits within Ballston’s established defense and technology ecosystem, near major government agencies and government contractors including DARPA and the Office of Naval Research.
